description.value: Spicy 6 Fine Indian Cuisine is a long-standing North Indian restaurant on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, established in 2012 and now operated by the Bassi family alongside Chef Ram, who brings a fine-dining background from India. The restaurant offers dine-in, pickup, and delivery, with a fully licensed bar and a weekday lunch buffet. Its central downtown location makes it a convenient stop for cyclists touring the West End or Stanley Park area.
